Ārdrā
(‘the wet’)
------------------------------------------
Ārdrā is the sixth नक्षत्र or constel-lation of स्तर्स् (of the twentyseven listed by the Hindu अस्त्रोनोम्य्). It is the star Alpha Orionis or Betelgeuse. In Hindu अस्त्रोलोग्य् it is considered malefic. Persons born under its influence will become vain, foolish and tend towards a sinful life. The day associated with this नक्षत्र is considered inauspicious for starting any new good venture.
See also NAKṢATRA.
